method: frozen B5 seed42 + Federated H1 + 105D C5 per-gas Ridge

track_G.name: harmonized filename-group-aware 5-fold
track_G.selection: per-gas alpha by calibration-only OOF RMSE
track_G.160_80_40: read-only reuse of SHA-verified official low-calibration results

track_H.name: historical window-level holdout downsizing
track_H.membership: fit subset only from frozen 240 fit pool; validation subset only from frozen 80 validation pool
track_H.nested: 40 subset_of 80 subset_of 160 separately inside fit and validation pools
track_H.selection: per-gas alpha by corresponding historical fit/validation split
track_H.final_refit: all fit+validation rows at current budget

decision_rule.degradation_metric: relative mean S_CC RMSE increase versus the same track's 320 baseline
decision_rule.obvious_protocol_magnitude_difference: maximum absolute lower-budget curve gap exceeds 20 percentage points
decision_rule.A: both tracks clearly degraded and maximum curve gap <=20 percentage points
decision_rule.B: both tracks clearly degraded and maximum curve gap >20 percentage points
decision_rule.C: mainly group-aware track clearly degraded; operational fallback when both-track criterion is not met

evidence_boundary: group-aware track uses the same five-fold selection protocol at all budgets
historical downsizing preserves original fit/validation pool membership
same previously used C5 test is evaluated descriptively
no protocol, model, subset, fold, alpha, or method is selected from test results
